# Ariyo Aziz Pratama — Portfolio

> Product Designer, Frontend (Vue.js / React), and Flutter Mobile Application Developer.

## Summary
Ariyo Aziz Pratama is a Product Designer and Informatics graduate based in Yogyakarta, Indonesia. He specializes in human-centered UI/UX design systems, modern responsive web applications using Vue 3 and React, and cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter.

## Core Capabilities
- UI/UX Architecture, Wireframing, Figma Design Systems & Prototyping
- Frontend Engineering with Vue 3, Vite, React, and Tailwind CSS
- Cross-Platform Mobile Application Development with Flutter and Dart
- Backend integration (Flask, PostgreSQL, MySQL, REST APIs)

## Key Pages & Navigation
- `/`: Main interactive homepage, profile manifesto, featured projects, career timeline, tech stack, and certificates preview.
- `/projects`: Complete archive of portfolio projects filterable by Programmer, UI/UX, and Photography domains.
- `/certificates`: Professional certifications, academic credentials, and course achievements.
- `/project/:slug`: Deep dive case studies for individual projects (e.g., VitaCal App, Semesta Kecil, FrameFlow, Dapur Vanny).
